content: Bosa, McCaffrey don't participate in 49ers' first Week 1 practice
sourcesChecked: NBC Sports Bay Area full article
materialAnalysisExtracted: Nick Bosa did not participate in the open portion of San Francisco's first full Week 1 practice in Melbourne after spending most of camp managing tendinitis in his surgically repaired right knee.
Bosa has explicitly said he expects to play against the Rams, so the absence is an availability/conditioning watch rather than evidence he is out.
Christian McCaffrey also did not participate in the open portion after a managed camp ramp-up; no official Monday participation designation was required because of the international scheduling setup.
George Kittle participated in individual drills, while Mike Evans, Romello Height and Renardo Green were back in drills after recent issues.
